# forumulate_webhook (Resource)

An organization webhook: an HTTPS endpoint that is sent signed events (`page.published`, `topic.created`, ...). It can be confined to one space or content library, narrowed by category, tag, group, content type and locale, and told whom to email when it keeps failing.

The signing secret is minted by the API once, at creation, and kept in the sensitive `secret` attribute. It is not recoverable afterwards: an imported webhook has no `secret`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_webhook" "publish" {
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/forumulate"
  events = ["page.published", "page.deleted"]

  # Only this space.
  space_id = forumulate_space.docs.id

  alert_contacts = ["ops@example.com"]
}

# The signing secret is shown by the API once and kept, sensitive, in state.
output "publish_webhook_secret" {
  value     = forumulate_webhook.publish.secret
  sensitive = true
}

# A Slack incoming webhook.
resource "forumulate_webhook" "slack" {
  url    = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX"
  format = "slack"
  events = ["topic.created"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) The events this endpoint hears, by name, at least one. `GET /webhooks/events` publishes the whole vocabulary with a sample payload for each.
- `url` (String) Where deliveries are POSTed: an absolute https URL, up to 2048 characters.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Set `false` to pause an endpoint while keeping its history and secret.
- `alert_contacts` (Set of String) Addresses emailed when the endpoint keeps failing (at 1 hour, at 24 hours, and when it is switched off). Up to 10. Leave out for the organization's owners.
- `body_encoding` (String) `json` (the default) or `form` for a receiver that cannot parse JSON bodies.
- `category_ids` (Set of String) Only events naming one of these forum categories (up to 100 category ids). Leave out for no filter (the endpoint hears the event wherever it happens).
- `content_types` (Set of String) Only `content.*` events for these content types (by key, up to 100). Leave out for no filter (the endpoint hears the event wherever it happens).
- `external_ref` (String) Your own reference, fixed at creation: a repeat create naming it answers the existing webhook (without its secret).
- `format` (String) The body shape: `json` (the default), or `slack` / `discord` for an incoming-webhook URL from either. Changing it replaces the webhook.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) Only group, user and badge events for these groups (up to 100 group ids). Leave out for no filter (the endpoint hears the event wherever it happens).
- `kind` (String) `webhook` (the default) delivers signed events; `deploy_hook` calls a Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare Pages deploy-hook URL on `content.*` events, unsigned and debounced. Changing it replaces the webhook.
- `library_id` (String) Confine the endpoint to one content library: `content.*` events from it only. Not together with `space_id`.
- `locales` (Set of String) Only `content.*` events in these locales (codes, or `default`; up to 100). Leave out for no filter (the endpoint hears the event wherever it happens).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form flat tags. Replaced whole when changed.
- `signature_version` (String) `v1` (the default for a new endpoint) is the timestamped signature; `both` adds the legacy replayable body-only one for receivers not yet migrated.
- `space_id` (String) Confine the endpoint to one space (its id). Leave out for organization-wide, including spaces created later. Not together with `library_id`.
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) Only events carrying one of these tags (by name, up to 100, 60 characters each). Leave out for no filter (the endpoint hears the event wherever it happens).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the webhook was registered.
- `id` (String) The webhook's id (a UUID).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret, shown by the API once at creation. Sensitive. Empty for an imported webhook.
- `state` (String) `healthy`, `failing` or `disabled`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An imported webhook has no `secret`: the API shows it only at creation.
terraform import forumulate_webhook.publish 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
